# Get the most recent spectrum

x = spec['raman_shift']
y = spec['intensity']

plt.plot(x, y)
plt.title(f"Spectrum at {spec['title']}")
plt.xlabel("Raman Shift (cm-1)")
plt.ylabel("Intensity")
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Simple peak detection to see if anything other than 520 exists
# We look for peaks outside the 510-530 range
mask = (x < 510) | (x > 530)
if len(y[mask]) > 0:
    max_val_outside = np.max(y[mask])
    print(f"Max intensity outside substrate region (510-530): {max_val_outside}")
else:
    print("No data outside substrate region")

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

spec = spectra[-1]
x = spec['raman_shift']
y = spec['intensity']

# Find peaks with a certain prominence to filter noise
peaks, properties = find_peaks(y, height=1000, prominence=500)

plt.plot(x, y)
plt.plot(x[peaks], y[peaks], "x")
plt.title(f"Peak detection at {spec['title']}")
plt.xlabel("Raman Shift (cm-1)")
plt.ylabel("Intensity")
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

print(f"Peaks found at: {x[peaks]}")
print(f"Peak intensities: {y[peaks]}")
